name: OneDev Issues Importer
description: Import OneDev issues into the Nimbalyst tracker as native items that link back to their source. Connects to your self-hosted OneDev server with an access token.
author: Ahmad

enablement.purpose: Read issues from your configured OneDev server so you can import them into the tracker.

serverUrl.description: Base URL of your OneDev server, e.g. https://onedev.example.com

username.description: Optional. If set, HTTP Basic auth (username:token) is used; if empty, the token is sent as a Bearer token.

apiToken.description: OneDev access token (user menu → Access Tokens on your server)

project.description: Optional. Explicit OneDev project path for this workspace (overrides git-remote detection).

openStates.description: Comma-separated issue state names treated as "open" (OneDev states are customizable per server)
